entities.summary: Licchavi Thakuri, a notable figure in the history of Nepal, associated with Thakuri Transitional Period and Western Kingdoms (879–1200). Preceded by Thakuri Period. Their legacy influenced Khas Malla Western Kingdom and Khas Malla.
